messages:
Nina Park: idea — quick Rooftop Popcorn & Praise next Fri 5:30pm. low-key end-of-week recog: popcorn bar, 3 peer-picked micro-grants ($50 e-gift), and 10 enamel mini-pins for in-person handoff. :popcorn: :sparkles:
Liam O'Connor: love it. rooftop capacity is 80, weather looking ok but backup is commons. Diego can coordinate tents?
Diego Rivera: yep can set up two 8ft tables + standing heaters if needed. vendor recs for popcorn carts: PoppedCo ($320) or KernelWorks ($365 with vegan oil).
Sana Kaur: RSVP form ready — includes remote option for swag shipping. link: http://tiny.redwood/pandp-rsvp
Priya Sharma: finance notes — $50 e-gift *per person* is below the $600 reporting threshold, but we still need receipts and to code to PEOPLE_SPOTAWARDS. international cards ok? some countries restrict gift cards as taxable. I'll need list of recipients by country.
Nina Park: good catch. plan: keep e-gifts $50 for US/CA, and ship a $50 physical gift + handwritten note for other countries to avoid card restrictions (Priya can confirm).
Liam O'Connor: pins for remote folks — can we order extra and mail in padded envelopes? shipping budget should be separate.
Priya Sharma: yes please include estimated shipping in the PO. if >50 packages we need a vendor shipping quote.
Eve-bot: Reminder: RSVP closes Tue 12pm.
Sana Kaur: volunteers: 1 pop bar attendant, 1 greeter, 1 shipping packer (post-event), 1 socials photographer. @Liam you ok to be greeter?
Liam O'Connor: happy to.
Diego Rivera: I'll be pop bar lead; need power outlet map from facilities. Samir from facilities not in channel — can someone ping him?
Nina Park: pinged Samir DM — he confirmed outlets near west stairwell.
Priya Sharma: procurement: we need vendor invoice + scope. Nina, can you collect menu and confirm vegan/peanut-free options?
Nina Park: will ask KernelWorks to provide allergy matrix and compostable cups. also optional caramel + chili-lime seasoning station.
Sana Kaur: recognition flow: open nominations until Wed 11:59pm. People Ops will shortlist, team votes Thu morning, winners announced Fri at event and via #general post.
Liam O'Connor: timeline: nominations close Wed 11:59pm, votes Thu 9-12, prizes purchased Thu PM, e-gifts scheduled Fri afternoon, mailers dropped Mon following.
Priya Sharma: for mailed packages we need customs-friendly descriptions. mark as "company appreciation item" valued at $20 to avoid customs delays? legal advises accurate value. I'll loop legal if needed.
Nina Park: remote inclusion: we'll do a 60-second live stream and drop a group photo in slack. Sana can run the phone camera and stream to #all-hands-live.
Sana Kaur: yes, will set up tripod + Sennheiser lav mic. need someone to intro winners on camera. Liam?
Liam O'Connor: can do a 60s intro. keep it tight.
Diego Rivera: to-dos: vendor booked by Thu EOD, PO to finance Thu AM, pins ordered Thu AM, RSVP close Tue noon, shipping manifest export Wed PM, volunteers confirmed Thu noon.
Priya Sharma: final: please put all receipts and shipping invoices into the PEOPLE_SPOTAWARDS folder and tag the card transaction ID. finance will reconcile next week.
Nina Park: thanks everyone. I'll post a final runbook Fri morning and create calendar invite with agenda + remote link. :white_check_mark:
Eve-bot: Event blocking: rooftop reserved Fri 5-6:30pm. Deploy window exception requested for 5:15-5:45pm.
